question: What is the air quality in Minden, Penang right now?
name: ChatGPT
answer:
Minden’s latest reported **Malaysia Air Pollutant Index (API) is 89 — Moderate**, at **5:00 p.m. MYT on October 15**. The station lists PM2.5 as the main contributor. Most people can continue normal outdoor activities, but unusually sensitive people may want to limit prolonged or strenuous exertion outdoors. ([jerebumalaysia.com](https://jerebumalaysia.com/en/stations/minden-pulau-pinang/?utm_source=openai))

Readings can change, and apps may show different values because they use different AQI scales.
